tasks.spec:
You are a code-feature worker implementing Phase 3b (application shell) of MonetaFox Reborn, a Microsoft Money replacement PWA. The repository is an existing, committed Vite + React 19 + TypeScript project at /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn (the REPO). Read plan-reborn.md (Phase 3) and spec.md (UI & UX) first. Phases 0/1/3a are done: crypto at src/lib/crypto/, the encrypted data layer at src/lib/db/, and Zustand domain stores at src/stores/ with an initializeStores(repos) unlock seam. Dark-mode theming and a ThemeToggle already exist from Phase 0.

BOUNDARY / OWNERSHIP: Edit files directly in the REPO working tree. You OWN only: src/App.tsx, src/App.test.tsx, src/main.tsx, src/components/** (add layout/nav/ui; keep the existing theme-toggle and ui/button), src/pages/** (create the route pages), src/routes.tsx (create), src/stores/authStore.ts (create), src/stores/index.ts (edit ONLY to add an authStore export), src/lib/store.ts (the Phase 0 demo counter store — DELETE it), and package.json (add react-router-dom only). Do NOT modify src/lib/crypto/**, src/lib/db/**, the other src/stores/* domain stores, src/test/setup.ts, the four .md files, or anything under .ringer/. Do NOT git commit or push.

INSTALL: add React Router v7 with `corepack pnpm add react-router-dom`. Add no other dependencies.

DELIVERABLE — a protected, navigable app shell with this EXACT testable seam (a hidden RTL contract test pins it; drift fails it):

1. src/stores/authStore.ts — export a Zustand store `useAuthStore` with state `{ isAuthenticated: boolean }` (default false) and actions `setAuthenticated(v: boolean)` (and optionally login/logout helpers). This is a STUB that Phase 2 replaces with real session logic — do not implement real auth. Export it from src/stores/index.ts too.

2. src/components/RequireAuth.tsx — a guard that renders its protected content (an <Outlet/> or children) when useAuthStore's isAuthenticated is true, and otherwise `<Navigate to="/login" replace />`.

3. src/components/Layout.tsx — the authenticated chrome: a PERSISTENT navigation (a <nav> or sidebar) with links (react-router <Link>/<NavLink>) to every main section, a header containing the existing ThemeToggle, and an <Outlet/> for the routed page. Accessible names on the nav links must match the section names below.

4. src/pages/** — one placeholder page component per section, each rendering an <h1> with the section name: Dashboard (route index '/'), Accounts ('/accounts'), Transactions ('/transactions'), Budgets ('/budgets'), Categories ('/categories'), Reports ('/reports'), Investments ('/investments'), Bills ('/bills'), Settings ('/settings'). Plus a Login page ('/login') that renders text including "Sign in" and a dev-only button that calls setAuthenticated(true) so the shell is explorable now (Phase 2 replaces this page with the real form). Plus a NotFound page rendering text including "Not Found" (or "404") for the catch-all '*' route.

5. src/routes.tsx — export a function component `AppRoutes` returning a react-router <Routes> element (NOT a Router — the app supplies the Router, tests supply a MemoryRouter): a public '/login' route; a protected branch where RequireAuth wraps the Layout as the parent element and each section page is a child route; and a '*' catch-all → NotFound. Only authenticated users see the Layout/nav.

6. src/App.tsx — render `<BrowserRouter><AppRoutes/></BrowserRouter>`. Remove all Phase 0 demo-counter code and its import of src/lib/store.ts; then DELETE src/lib/store.ts. Rewrite src/App.test.tsx so it no longer tests the counter — test that the shell renders (e.g. wrap AppRoutes in a MemoryRouter and assert the login or a section page shows). Keep at least one real passing test.

7. Expand the shadcn/ui component set minimally where the shell needs it (e.g. a Card for page scaffolding). Keep it boring and consistent with the existing ui/button + cn() util.

HOW TO VERIFY before finishing (from REPO root): `corepack pnpm run typecheck`, `corepack pnpm run test`, `corepack pnpm run lint`, `corepack pnpm run build` — all must exit 0.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: make the changes in owned paths, then write ./notes.md in your task dir: what you read, files created/changed/deleted, commands run with results, the route map, how the RequireAuth + useAuthStore seam works (for Phase 2), and any assumption or follow-up.

HARD RULES: match the exported names exactly (AppRoutes, RequireAuth, useAuthStore, page headings, nav link names, login 'Sign in' text, NotFound text); authStore is a stub — no real auth; do not touch the crypto/db/domain-store code; keep it typed and boring; do not commit.
tasks.verified: A hidden RTL routing contract test passes (unauthenticated protected route redirects to /login; authenticated shows the section page + persistent nav to all main sections; distinct pages per route; 404 catch-all); react-router-dom is installed; RequireAuth/useAuthStore/AppRoutes seams exist; the Phase 0 demo store is deleted and unreferenced; the Phase 1 and 3a contract tests still pass; and typecheck + suite + lint + build all exit 0. Only owned paths changed; nothing committed.
